summary: Iteration 3: Unified-channel (timeslot) feature testing. Backend: 35 passed / 1 documented skip (36 total). New test_channels.py covers GET /api/channels shape, PATCH admin/non-admin/invalid-slot, /api/inject with channel, /api/radios?channel=1|2 filter, last_channel persistence + update, positions.channel field, and status.listener.stats.voice_relayed=0 (no MMDVMs in preview). All prior 28 v1.1/v1.2 tests still pass. Frontend: verified login -> dashboard, CHANNELS (TIMESLOTS) panel with ALL/CH1/CH2 chips + admin edit gears, injector CH dropdown injects on CH2 and roster row shows CH2 badge, CH2 filter narrows roster to 2 CH2-only radios, ALL restores 9 rows, admin rename updates chip label to 'Ops Net' with 'Channel renamed' toast (WS channels_changed broadcast working - no reload needed), channel+group filter intersects correctly.

minor.issue: channel_store returned via db.channels.find().to_list(10) hardcoded upper bound; harmless (only 2 slots) but non-obvious. Consider to_list(None) or explicit limit=2.

ui_bugs.issue: The uncontrolled input uses defaultValue={channel?.name}; when the modal re-opens for the SAME channel after a rename, the input still shows the old defaultValue until the Dialog remounts. Not blocking - Save falls back to channel.name if input untouched. Consider keying <input> by channel.slot or making it fully controlled.
(Carried over from iter2) React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Fix ChannelEditModal to use controlled inputs keyed on channel.slot so pre-fill reflects latest name after subsequent renames.
(Optional) Prior-iteration open items still valid: <span> in <option> hydration warning; DialogDescription/aria-describedby on some Radix modals; add talkgroup_id to InjectPayload for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: dmr_ingest.py::VOICE_SLOT/DATA_SLOT env vars still imported but never used in the unified-channel logic (relay is unconditional). Docstring at file top still says 'If the frame is on the VOICE_SLOT ... relay it' which is now stale - both slots relay. Cleanup for clarity.

channels.py::ChannelStore.update ignores unknown keys silently. Fine, but empty string for name would still be persisted; consider min_length validation at the Pydantic layer (ChannelUpdate.name has max_length=48 but no min_length).

server.py record_packet writes last_channel = packet.get('channel') or 1 - meaning a legacy radio (no last_channel) will be treated as CH1 on next update; but /radios?channel=1 query on the DB still requires the field to exist. That's the documented behavior per the review request (old radios excluded from ?channel filter by design). OK.
ChannelFilter Chip button uses inline style backgroundColor; no aria-pressed for active state. Minor a11y.
GET /api/channels response never limits fields for size; fine since only 2 docs.
seed_data_creation: test_channels.py creates two ephemeral radios (dmr_id ~6210000+) and deletes them; renames slot=1 during test and restores name to 'Channel 1'. Frontend test also renamed CH1 to 'Ops Net' then restored to 'Channel 1'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_channels.py (11 tests). All prior test files unchanged and still passing. Real MMDVM UDP path (voice frame relay) cannot be exercised in preview - verified only via unit assertion that voice_relayed counter exists and is 0. The channels collection is seeded on startup (ChannelStore.seed_defaults) and slot uniqueness index enforced.
